Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
fix: SendPulse email service not sending signup emails

Root cause: email.service.ts was calling this.transporter.sendMail\(\) even 
when EMAIL_PROVIDER=sendpulse. But for SendPulse, this.transporter is just 
an empty object {}, not a nodemailer transporter.

Fix: Detect EMAIL_PROVIDER and call sendpulseService.sendEmail\(\) directly 
when using SendPulse, bypassing the nodemailer transporter.

This enables welcome emails to be sent to new users after signup.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix pool assignment ID type mismatch

- Remove manual UUID assignment for torbox_pool_assignments.id  
- Use PostgreSQL RETURNING clause to get auto-generated integer ID
- Fixes ''invalid input syntax for type integer'' error when creating pool assignments

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
